name: Examplify Network+
description: Exam readiness tool for CompTIA Network+ (N10-009): port drills, subnetting practice, an acronym gym, a PBQ lab, troubleshooting steps, mini-exams, and a one-page cram sheet. To add it to a note, open Tools > Examplify Network+ > How to use and click Copy command, then paste into a note. Or type ```net+ on one line and ``` on the next.
author: Ben
